utfall: grein 3: andel som går videre til fagskole innen tre år etter fullført yrkesfag (høyest av alle utdanningsprogram), gjengitt fra Olsen et al. 2014
sitat: The share of students continuing at vocational colleges varies from field to field, but it is highest for the field of technical and industrial production (16% of students three years after the completion of VET, Olsen et al., 2014).

utfall: grein 3: andel med yrkesfaglig bakgrunn blant universitetsstudentene, 1–9 prosent etter fagfelt i 2011, gjengitt fra Nyen et al. 2013
sitat: In all Nordic countries, entrance to traditional science universities with a VET background is much rarer. In Finland, the rate in 2001 was 0–13 percent, depending on the field (Vuorinen-Lampila and Valkonen, 2012). In Norway, around 1–9 percent in 2011 (Nyen et al., 2013).
